title: quant trading with AI
author: Suspicious-Sir9374
selftext: recommend me something about neobrokers, trading, strategies, and AI tools for traders.

comments.author: Suspicious-Sir9374
comments.body:
I recently came across a solid tool for quantitative analysis and strategy backtesting called Horizon Trade.

To see its capabilities in action, you can read this[research on the NVDA post-earnings drift](https://x.com/pazhik_ido/status/2092556556130754981). The author used the platform to analyze 14 quarterly earnings reports, measure 20-day holding returns, and evaluate max drawdowns and regime changes.

It looks like a great environment if you want to test your own trading ideas and market hypotheses without building complex infrastructure from scratch. The author of the article also mentions they offer credits to run your own research.
